default.faq1a1: The Journey Premium License is a one-time purchase that unlocks all paid features on the platform that you've bought from. The Monthly/Annual Membership is a subscription service that unlocks Journey on all platforms. There is also an option to purchase Membership for Lifetime. For more detailed comparison, you can refer to the in-app comparison provided in the [knowledge base](%1$s).
default.faq1q: What is the difference between Premium and Membership?
default.faq2a1: You can upgrade to 200GB of shared storage and 50,000 entries partitioned across up to 4 drives through Journey Signature.
default.faq2q1: What happens if I go over 10GB of storage or make more than 5,000 journal entries in Journey Cloud Sync?
default.faq3a: You do not need to purchase the Membership license separately on each device/platform as the Membership license unlocks Journey on all platforms.
default.faq3q: Is it necessary to buy a separate Membership license for each device/platform?
default.faq4a: To restore your purchase, please go to Settings > Addons > tap Restore Purchase.
default.faq4q: I've switched to a new phone. How can I transfer my Membership license?
default.faq5a: No, we do not sell user's journal data. We take privacy seriously and are committed to protecting our users' information.
default.faq5q: Does Journey sell users' journal data to third parties?
default.faq6a:
The membership fee is essential for covering the expenses associated with maintaining cloud-based features, including hosting and providing a secure experience for all members.

Differently from many journaling apps, Journey does not generate income through advertising revenue. Moreover, we firmly commit to not selling users' data to third parties.
default.faq6q: Why do I need to pay to enjoy membership?
default.feature1_text: Experience Journey's transformative power on all platforms with exclusive access. Seamlessly sync your experiences, from the convenience of your smartphone to the versatility of your tablet and the comfort of your desktop.
default.feature2_text: Protect your most intimate thoughts and cherished memories with Journey's state-of-the-art end-to-end encryption. Experience unparalleled peace of mind as your personal journal remains securely encrypted from creation to storage, ensuring only you have access to your private world.
default.feature3_text: Collaborate and create together as you embark on a collective journey of memories, insights, and experiences. Whether it's a group adventure, or a communal diary, the shared journal feature provides a platform for shared expression, fostering stronger bonds and cherished moments that will last a lifetime.
default.feature4a_text: Generate web links for selected entries in Journey Cloud Sync to share your journal with others. You can also add a passcode to share your journal entries with only selected individuals.
default.feature5_text: With just a few simple clicks, your cherished memories can be transformed into elegantly designed eBooks. Cloud Print offers a new way to celebrate and immortalize your experiences, ensuring that your stories can be treasured by you and future generations.
default.feature6_text: Export your journals to ePUB and DOCX formats, turning them into beautiful eBooks. Supported by applications like Apple Books, Amazon Kindle, and Microsoft Word, these formats make it easy to read and share your journal entries with anyone.

default.stories_edward_subtitle: Learn why Edward trusts Journey for personal journaling.
default.stories_edward_text: Edward, an IT consultant from Singapore, explained why he trusts Journey and has used it for five years. He likes that the app keeps his data safe with end-to-end encryption and a biometric lock. Privacy is very important these days. Journey lets me write down my thoughts and experiences without worrying, Edward said. Because he cares a lot about keeping his information protected, it makes Journey the perfect app for him.
default.stories_edward_title: Why Edward Trusts Journey as His Loyal Companion
default.stories_gplay_text1: In a remarkable achievement that's definitely worth chronicling in a journal, Journey has just been awarded Best Everyday Essentials 2023 in the Google Play Store. This accolade is part of the Google Play’s Best of 2023 awards, a significant annual event that recognizes and celebrates the most impressive apps and games available on the platform.
default.stories_gplay_text2: Google Play’s acknowledgment is indicative of the app's transformative appeal. It is a testament to the time and thoughtfulness that we have poured into creating Journey — an app that doesn't just capture daily activities but also encapsulates the essence of individual growth and reflection. The recognition from Google Play demonstrates that Journey has become an essential part of many users' lives, and that's a profound endorsement.
default.stories_gplay_title: Journey Won Best of Everyday Essentials 2023
default.stories_jonathan_subtitle: Deep dive into Jonathan's experience with Journey.
default.stories_jonathan_text: Jonathan, a London native and travel influencer who has journeyed through over 30 countries, found the Journey immensely helpful. Post-graduation, he began chronicling his adventures, using Journey as his travel diary. Journey transformed my travel storytelling, Jonathan shares. I document my experiences, pin locations on the map, and even log weather and activities. He appreciates the ability to share his escapades with followers through a simple web link, making his narratives accessible and engaging.
default.stories_jonathan_title: How a Travel Influencer Document & Share His Adventures Across 30 Countries
default.stories_wendy_subtitle: Learn how Wendy Wood keeps her family connected.
default.stories_wendy_text: Wendy Wood, a yoga instructor and mom in Seattle, loves using Journey to connect with her family. With Journey's shared journal, she easily shares her feelings, daily activities, and even photos and videos with her husband and kids. Before Journey, her busy life made it hard to update her family. Now, they can easily see what she's doing and feel more connected, even when they're all busy. Wendy says, Journey has been a beautiful, easy way for me to share my life with my loved ones. It brings us closer, letting my family see into my day, share laughs, and enjoy small moments together, no matter how busy we are. It's really helped us become closer.
default.stories_wendy_title: How Journey's Shared Journal Connects Friends & Family
